sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: A guided tour of a page: one step at a time, each a card beside the part of the page it is about, that part cut out of a dimmed page and outlined.

anatomy.spotlight: Over the page: the step's target cut out of a dim in scrim, 4 around it, rounded by radius-control and outlined 2 in primary; it moves to each step's target. A step with no target, or one not on the page, dims the whole page. The page under the dim takes no presses.
anatomy.card: A popover 320 wide, 12 from the target on its side (bottom by default, flipped where there is no room), or in the middle of the page without a target: a column 12 apart.
anatomy.head: The step's title (the popover's title), and at the line's end where the tour is at text.xs in muted-foreground.
anatomy.body: The step's words, as the popover's description.
anatomy.actions: Skip tour (ghost, small) at the start; at the end Back (outline, small) from the second step, then Next (small), or Done on the last.

steps.does: Each step: its target's selector, title, words and side.

onOpenChange.does: Called with false when the tour ends: done, skipped, or Escape.

onStepChange.does: Called with the step moved to.

rest.means: A step shown beside its target.

centered.means: A step with no target: the card in the middle, the whole page dimmed.
centered.reached: a step without a target, or one not on the page

rest.note: The dim around it in scrim.

keyboard.does: Moves on, or ends the tour on the last step: the focus starts on Next.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
